## Current Regime Read

## Analytical Framework

Monetary policy → inflation → growth → liquidity → credit.
Key sources: FRED, BLS, CME FedWatch, US Treasury, BIS/IMF.

## Active Themes

- Fed rate cut timing and pace (market vs. dot plot divergence).
- Fiscal deficit sustainability (US debt/GDP).
- China stimulus efficacy and property sector resolution.
- Geopolitical supply shocks (energy, semiconductors).

## Key Indicators to Track

- 2s10s yield curve spread (inversion → recession signal).
- Real Fed Funds Rate (restrictive when high and positive).
- Global M2 (leads risk assets ~3 months).
- ISM Manufacturing PMI (below 50 = contraction).
- JOLTS quits rate (labour market confidence proxy).
